report.title: UKSI taxon ranks for tanhub
report.description: A list of UKSI taxon ranks for tanhub.
report.query: SELECT #columns# FROM taxon_ranks tr -- Return every rank used by the imported hierarchy. JOIN cache_taxa_taxon_lists cttl ON tr.id=cttl.taxon_rank_id AND cttl.taxon_list_id=#taxon_list_id# WHERE tr.deleted=false

param.name: taxon_list_id
param.description: ID of the taxon list to load higher taxa for.
